remarks: Welcome to One Duffy's Lane, an exceptional 5-bedroom, 4.2-bath residence offering 4,966 square feet of refined living space on a private .65-acre lot. Perfectly positioned at the entrance of a highly sought-after cul-de-sac, this home combines timeless design with modern comfort. A spacious two-story foyer welcomes you upon entry, featuring a sweeping staircase and dramatic ceiling heights. Bathed in natural light, the sun-filled interiors showcase elegant architectural details and a thoughtfully designed, flexible layout suited for today's lifestyle. The heart of the home is the open-concept kitchen and family room, anchored by a gas fireplace-ideal for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. French doors lead to a covered deck overlooking a level, private backyard featuring a heated gunite pool with an electronic safety cover. The formal dining room is enhanced by a wet bar and beverage refrigerator, creating an inviting space for hosting. A dedicated home office offers a quiet retreat for work or study. Upstairs, a spacious bonus room provides versatility as a recreation room, playroom, or sleepover space. The third floor adds exceptional flexibility, ideal for an au pair suite with sitting area or a private media room. Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage with a convenient service entrance and a lower level that is framed and unfinished, offering outstanding potential for future expansion. Located near schools, beach, train, shops & YMCA
